index.emailHint: System emails (email verification codes, instance and billing notices) stop being sent once disabled.
index.smsHint: System SMS messages (verification codes) stop being sent once disabled.
index.referralDesc: Top-up compliance threshold and how referral rewards are calculated.
index.topUpVerificationHint: When enabled, users who have not completed identity verification cannot top up their account balance; turn it off for deployments outside mainland China.
index.referralEnabledHint: When off, new orders no longer issue rewards; rewards already issued are unaffected.
index.rewardRateHint: Used when the referrer matches no member level; levels use their own rate. Reward = order amount × rate.
index.rewardFreezeDaysHint: Rewards land in the frozen balance and can be withdrawn after this many days, covering refunds and disputes.
index.withdrawMinHint: A user cannot withdraw less than this amount.
index.automationDesc: Timed rules for instance lifecycle, billing reminders, product sync, ticket cleanup and upstream balance; each section's run frequency only applies to that section.
index.serviceLifecycleDesc: Unpaid services are suspended first and terminated after a longer grace period; the two timers run separately.
index.expireSuspendDaysHint: 0 suspends on the expiry day; N suspends once the service is N days past expiry.
index.terminateDaysHint: Counted from the suspension time, at least 1 day; only runs when termination is enabled.
index.scheduleModeHint: Every 15/30 minutes follows heartbeat slots; only hourly and daily use the time below.
index.scheduleTimeHint: Hourly uses only the minute, daily uses the full time, and every 15/30 minutes ignores it.
index.billingReminderDesc: Renewal invoices are created from the due date first; one reminder before it is due, then a day-based ladder after it is overdue.
index.remindBeforeDueDaysHint: Sends one reminder N days before the due date; 0 reminds on the due date.
index.overdueRemindDaysHint: Comma-separated days after the due date, for example 1,3,5.
index.overdueAfterDaysHint: Invoices are marked overdue N days after the due date; 0 marks them the day after it is due.
index.productDescriptionSyncDesc: Syncs product descriptions in bulk through vendor APIs; those APIs are rate-limited, so keep the interval loose.
index.ticketCleanupDesc: Ticket auto-closing and unpaid invoice cleanup run on separate schedules and do not affect each other.
index.ticketAutoCloseHint: Only closes tickets that staff already replied to and the customer never followed up.
index.ticketAutoCloseHoursHint: Closes a ticket and notifies the customer once it has been silent for this many hours after the staff reply.
index.cleanupIntervalHint: Unpaid invoices, orders and top-ups expire by the payment session TTL (5 minutes); the frequency only changes how often they are scanned.
index.upstreamBalanceAlertDesc: Repeat interval of the upstream balance alert and how long credit change records are kept.
index.upstreamLogRetentionHint: Upstream credit change records older than this are purged automatically. Records are written only when the balance changes and take very little space; keep them longer for later reconciliation.
index.balanceAlertHint: While the upstream balance stays below the threshold, admins are reminded again every interval. Once it recovers above the threshold the alert clears immediately, and it fires again as soon as it drops without waiting for the interval.
index.logArchiveDesc: pt-archiver runtime parameters plus retention for logs and archive files; the archive directory is fixed under backend storage and cannot be changed here.
index.runtimeParamsDesc: Point at the installed pt-archiver and the defaults file holding database credentials; both paths must be readable by the backend process.
index.archiverBinaryPathHint: The archive task runs this binary directly; update it when the install location changes.
index.archiverConfigFileHint: Defaults file holding the database credentials; mode 600 and readable only by the backend process.
index.maxConcurrencyHint: How many tables are moved at once; lower it for large tables or a loaded primary.
index.batchSizeHint: Rows moved from the live table per batch; smaller is gentler on the primary and takes longer.
index.batchIntervalHint: Pause between batches; raise it when the primary is under pressure during archiving.
index.retentionPolicyDesc: Logs past retention are archived and deleted from the live table; archive CSVs are removed when they expire.
index.logRetentionDaysHint: Log rows older than this are moved out and deleted from the live table.
index.archiveRetentionDaysHint: Archive CSVs are deleted after this many days, and the expired data can no longer be queried.
